protocol.budget: At most two current source records per query. Both plans use the same scoring output and threshold; staged execution is not adaptive content-conditioned inference.
protocol.calibration: Historical confidence breakpoints only; maximize balanced known evidence coverage and unknown rejection. No finite-sample safety guarantee.
protocol.controls: BM25 scores the full visible source text within the same resolved module. History nearest uses the same canonical/past observations and maps their known heading targets into the current module. Single classifier sees full original query text, and its logits are normalized within the same module mask.
protocol.costs: Actual model+Adam payloads, complete history index, common raw corpus/registry/BM25 index, shared preparation, individual fit receipts, serial query scoring, calibration, source read counts/bytes and full wall/CPU including interruption. File artifacts include all comparators, not one deployment allocation.
limits: Same-corpus method development after prior BCE and categorical observations, not independent confirmation.
Three model seeds share one source corpus and fixed query sets.
Document-arrival phases are an authored curriculum, not production history.
This tests evidence addressing and source reads; all raw source content is retained and no parametric content-compression benefit is claimed.
Literal module names are explicitly present in this task; unrestricted language/entity resolution is not tested.
Top1 twice and top2 use the same frozen scores and equal two-read budget; equality verifies execution/accounting, not a distinct learned-planning advantage.
protocol.registry: All modes share exact public module matching and latest available module/heading record versions. No query gold module, type, source ID or target count enters routing.
protocol.time_contract: Initialization uses phase-0 training queries. Later phases train only canonical newly available sources and previous-phase query observations; calibration uses earlier-phase calibration rows. Every held phase is read after thresholds and checkpoint identity are fixed.
protocol.training: Every model gets current canonical sources plus the same observed past query targets, with 240 minibatches of 32. Shared 15-heading intent and direct 600-source classifier use their natural output contracts; equal presentations do not imply equal parameter count, per-row draw sequence or FLOPs. Unknown target rows are not categorical source labels.
